android.desc:
The Update Android System application easily updates your Android system modules and applications. It makes your Android system more secure and updates your Android device to the latest version.

You can check for updates of the following modules.
1. Android Core OS
2. Essential components for Android system
3. Installed applications

With this app, you can check for update of Android core OS components of your Android device and confirm the installed list of the components in your device.

By updating the Android core OS components, you can have the following advantages. The update feature is supported from Android 10.
‣ Security fixes
‣ Privacy enhancements
‣ Consistency improvements

This application also gathers list of installed applications and provides shortcuts to Google Play Store for each application and so on.

Supported features for each application
• Launch an application
• Check for updates on Google Play Store
• Share an application
• View application information
• Open in the Settings application
• Filter out applications by search
